name: Sparkline
tagline: A compact trend chart over any Dataverse view.
summary:
Draws the records a view returns as one small series, as a line, an area or columns, sized to sit in a form section beside the values it summarises. Bind a numeric column to **Value** and optionally a column to **Label**.

- The view is the query: change its filter or its sort and the chart follows
- Every point is a keyboard stop whose value is announced to screen readers
- Asks for no permissions

limitations: Expand takes over the browser window here, as it takes the form area on a form: the control calls context.mode.setFullScreen() and the demo honours it. The bar above the chart, with Exit full screen, is this site's, standing in for the platform's own way out. Leave by the bar and the control is not asked, as on a form: it is told, and its button goes back to Expand.

Records to chart works here: the control asks the view for that many records, and the demo returns that many from the fixture, so set it to 6 and the chart draws January to June. The presets ask for 100, more than the twelve months the fixture holds. On a real view it is how many records the series is drawn from, capped by the platform at 250.

The order is the fixture's. On a view the order is the view's own sort, applied server-side — this control never reorders records in the browser, because a client-side sort would reorder only the records it was handed and not the view behind them. There is no sort behind this origin for it to follow.

presets.name: Line
presets.description: Twelve months of revenue as a line. The domain is the range of the data, so the shape of the year is what the chart is about.

presets.name: Area
presets.description: The same readings filled to the baseline, which reads as volume rather than as movement.

presets.name: Columns
presets.description: The same readings as columns — and the one preset whose domain starts at zero, because a column encodes magnitude by length and a non-zero baseline would lie about the ratios.

presets.name: Tall, no expanding
presets.description: A taller chart with the Expand button switched off — the configuration for a form section that is already the size it wants to be.
